svg.title: In-System Sailing Yacht - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Small Craft Catalogue (2023), printed 77-78, PDF 78-79. Deployed-sail top projection combines broad curved solar-sail panels with the larger Deck 2 hull; Decks 1 and 3 fit within that envelope. Bow right rotated up. Sail extent follows the plan and deployed illustration; fine rigging excluded and sail panels filled solid for token clarity. This depicts sails deployed.
